questions.question: I'm working through the Industrial Control System patterns view, CAPEC-703 — for the attack patterns collected under it, what other names does each of those also go by?
For HTTP Response Splitting, CAPEC-34, which attack patterns sit alongside it as peers, and for each of those peers, which attack patterns can come after it?
For the menuPass group, G0045, which malware and tools do they rely on, and what techniques does each of those pieces of malware and tooling carry out?
Which malware and tools make use of Dynamic Linker Hijacking, T1574.006, and which threat groups are known to use each of those?
For Hijacking a privileged process, CAPEC-234, which attack patterns can lead up to it, keeping just the ones rated Medium for likelihood of attack?
Looking at Hijacking a privileged process, CAPEC-234 — which attack patterns can come before it, counting only those with a typical severity of High?
Once Phishing, CAPEC-98, has been pulled off, which attack patterns can come next, limited to the ones whose likelihood of attack is Low?
After Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords, CAPEC-70, which attack patterns can follow on from it, just the High severity ones?
Using Meta-characters in E-mail Headers to Inject Malicious Payloads, CAPEC-41, is a narrower case of what broader attack patterns — only the ones at the Standard level of abstraction?
What broader attack patterns is Android Activity Hijack, CAPEC-501, a more specific instance of, keeping only those with a typical severity of Very High?
In the Industrial Control System patterns view, CAPEC-703, which of the attack patterns it gathers are written at the Meta level of abstraction?
Of the attack patterns collected in the ICS patterns view, CAPEC-703, which ones have a Low likelihood of attack?
Which of the attack patterns filed under the Hardware category, CAPEC-515, are still in Draft status?
Among the attack patterns that the Industrial Control System patterns view, CAPEC-703, brings together, which ones are still marked Draft?
Which of the attack patterns grouped under the Communications category, CAPEC-512, carry a typical severity of Medium?
Within the ICS patterns view, CAPEC-703, are there any attack patterns whose typical severity is only Very Low, and if so which ones?
Which attack patterns are peers of Using UTF-8 Encoding to Bypass Validation Logic, CAPEC-80, narrowed down to the ones with a High likelihood of attack?
For Exploitation of Thunderbolt Protection Flaws, CAPEC-665, which of its peer attack patterns have a typical severity of Medium?
Which of the techniques that Restrict File and Directory Permissions, M1022, defends against actually apply to Windows?
Of the techniques that Disable or Remove Feature or Program, M1042, helps mitigate, which ones are relevant to SaaS?
Which techniques does Antivirus/Antimalware, M1049, mitigate that are applicable to macOS?
For the C0011 campaign, which of the techniques it used fall under the PRE platform?
In Operation Dream Job, C0022, which of the malware and tools the operators used run on Windows?
For the Cutting Edge campaign, C0029, which of the malware and tools involved target network devices?
Which of the malware and tools used in the Cutting Edge campaign, C0029, work against Linux?
In the ArcaneDoor campaign, C0046, which of the techniques used apply to Windows?
For Operation AkaiRyū, C0060, which of the techniques the campaign used are relevant to an identity provider?
Which of the malware and tools that Ke3chang, G0004, works with are Windows based?
Of the techniques APT1, G0006, has used, which ones apply to macOS?
Which of the malware and tools APT29, G0016, uses are aimed at an identity provider?
Among the malware and tools APT29, G0016, relies on, which ones target an office suite?
Which of the malware and tools that Dark Caracal, G0070, uses run on Linux?
